answer: Locks are entered in juniper, expire in basalt, and bridge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 33 aliases hence needs 102 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4480 identities would post 1111 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
